description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order to remove the item, Full Cream Milk Powder from order No. 39 that published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1975/68, w.e.f. 04.05.2018
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It specifically removes an item (Full Cream Milk Powder) from a previous regulatory order. This constitutes a regulatory matter and a modification to existing regulations, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
